original_finding.status: New conditional source-level lifecycle finding; standalone public API case, actual application use and intended empty-query contract unresolved
original_finding.condition: A GpuBvh first completes/submits a valid nonempty build, then record_build or build is called with count zero without replacing the buffers, and a later generated traversal is invoked without an external count-zero guard. The query box intersects a previously stored primitive path and no other writer changes those buffers.
original_finding.observation: record_build assigns self.count = 0 and returns before recording any clearing/build dispatch, so existing node, index and child buffers are not changed by that call. bind exports only the buffers, not count. The generated query initializes the stack with root node zero and traverses encoded nodes with no empty-count check, so under the stated condition it can invoke the callback for an old primitive despite the host count being zero. A fresh never-built zero tree is a separate case; its device buffer contents and outcome are not asserted. MeshCollider::new rejects empty triangles, so ordinary constructor use does not establish this empty transition.
original_finding.historical_relation: 059 /root/lens12_frontier READ-L12-CONNECTED-TEAM-020 explicitly warned that zero host count and retained allocated buffers alone do not prove a query failure; this current separately registered traversal body supplies the missing unconditional root read and callback path. 774 rig RIG-OWNER-REACHED-PRODUCER-TRACE-005 scoped zero build/refit but excluded BVH algorithms, and RIG-PPS-F003 concerns lower byte/error propagation. Related, not automatic aliases to CPU ray-box empty or endpoint contracts.
original_finding.future_direction: Define empty BVH representation and generated-query behavior at the shared BVH owner. If zero builds are admitted, carry an explicit active-count/empty state to traversal or produce a safe empty root, while preserving nonempty build/refit order and public callers. No implementation is authorized.

original_finding.status: New conditional source-level admission/aggregate observation; supported negative thickness and device outcome unresolved
original_finding.condition: A finite negative MeshSurface.thickness is passed or assigned and record_bounds is reached. For some triangle axis, the actual f32 operations min_axis − thickness and max_axis + thickness produce lower > upper; e.g. mathematically any axis extent strictly less than twice the magnitude with sufficient representable margin has this relation.
original_finding.observation: The public surface is accepted without a local finite/nonnegative check. record_bounds passes thickness as the margin; the triangle-bounds shader text computes min(vertices) − margin and max(vertices) + margin, then sends those raw boxes to BVH build/refit. For the stated input the generated interval is inverted, so it cannot represent an ordinary lower/upper enclosure on that axis. The later contact search binds thickness plus particle radius. No GPU compilation, execution, input witness, or observed missed collision is claimed.
original_finding.historical_relation: 059 Adler READ-L11-373 left finite surface parameter policy pending; /root/lens12_frontier READ-L12-865 and 774 rig TRACE-005 documented raw surface and margin roles without asserting a negative-margin or finite policy. Existing physics-contact resource-coherence/swept-contact findings concern different operations. Central must reconcile exact identity and decide supported input policy.
original_finding.future_direction: Establish allowed shell/friction values and the owning constructor/mutation boundary. If thickness must be nonnegative and finite, admit it there and keep triangle-bound and response semantics synchronized; preserve legitimate zero and native error behavior.

Native backend validation and any actual huge input or failure remain unproved.
